title: Open-Less/openless
claim: Open-Less/openless — Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Win
why_good: Hold-to-talk voice input that drops AI-polished text at your cursor in any app — a slick, universal dictation UX people already pay Wispr Flow for.
value: Prosumer subscription (like Wispr Flow / Superwhisper); open-source + local is the privacy wedge.
risk: Wispr Flow, Superwhisper and OS-native dictation are here; needs quality + latency to win, and voice UIs are crowded.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that enhances productivity through AI-polished text generation, which can be monetized.

zh.claim: Open-Less/openless —— 按住键说话、松开,AI 润色后的文字出现在任意 app 的光标处。开源语音输入。
zh.why_good: 按住说话、在任意 app 光标处落下 AI 润色文字——一个顺滑、通用的听写体验,人们已经在为 Wispr Flow 付费。
zh.value: 专业订阅(像 Wispr Flow / Superwhisper);开源 + 本地是隐私切口。
zh.risk: Wispr Flow、Superwhisper 和系统原生听写都在;要靠质量 + 延迟取胜,语音 UI 很挤。
